bundle.shortDescription: See what is running on your machine.
bundle.longDescription: LocalDocks is a local development dashboard for Windows. It shows the services, processes and listening ports you own, alongside system CPU, memory, network, storage, GPU and thermal telemetry. It runs unelevated, keeps every measurement on your machine, and reports what it cannot measure rather than inventing a value.
